summary: FOUR rows, and the two labels split 1-3: AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' is RIGHT on ep 24 and WRONG on 1, 127 and 157; animefillerguide's bucket (which our lib now reads as filler) is right on those three and wrong on 24. Stored types: all four mixed -> ep 24 CONFIRMED mixed, eps 1 / 127 / 157 corrected to FILLER. No anchors: not one of the four rows is anchorable, and each refusal has its own A44 basis, none of them 'behind'. THE PREMISE FAILS ON ITS FACE FIRST (second time on this series, third in the batch): the task and the context say AFG 'prints FILLER (red, no chapter) on all four'. On the live page (slug /anime/boruto/) all four rows are BLUE with the note '* Anime Canon' and Chapters = 'N/A' — 01. 'Boruto Uzumaki! * Anime Canon | N/A', 24. 'Boruto and Sarada * Anime Canon | N/A', 127. 'Make-Out Tactics * Anime Canon | N/A', 157. “Kara’s Footprints * Anime Canon | N/A”; the nearest red row is 156 'I Can't Stay in My Slim Form * Filler'. The 'filler' in the flag is OURS and it is CORRECT: lib/afg.ts now maps blue + an 'Anime Canon' note to filler (the wave-2 fix landed), which is T27's reading of that bucket. So AFG makes NO chapter claim and NO red-filler claim on any of the four; the disagreement is AFL's over-generous Mixed bucket against AFG's Anime-Canon bucket. Nobody printed a false chapter number — AFL simply calls a two-minute cold open and a closing status report 'Mixed'. THE ACCOUNTING, on three legs beyond the two labels. (1) Narutopedia's per-episode chapter field, in its machine-readable form (SMW askargs [[Anime::Boruto]][[Manga Chapter::+]], 71 rows), with the `Manga` qualifier that separates the two chapter SPACES: ep 1 -> Boruto ch 1; ep 24 -> NARUTO chs 700 and 705 (= 700+5); ep 127 -> not in the map at all; ep 157 -> Boruto ch 11. (2) The chapters' own Narutopedia pages, read against the episodes' synopses — this is what sizes each tie. (3) TV Tokyo's own per-episode synopses (the licensor; the live site paginates only eps 184-293, so these came from Wayback snapshots), plus ja-Wikipedia's article prose and its arc table. PER ROW. EP 1 — the source share is the pre-OP cold open and nothing else: Boruto ch 1 opens on Boruto facing Kawaki on Naruto's destroyed face in the Hokage Rock, Kawaki declaring the age of shinobi over, the Jōgan (the chapter page's own first lines), and ja-WP states the relation in one sentence — 「冒頭場面こそ漫画と同じだが、…漫画の1話目から映像化するのではなく、前日譚となる「忍者学校入学編」から始まる」 ('the opening scene alone is the same as the manga, but rather than adapting from the manga's chapter 1 it starts with the prequel Academy Entrance arc'). The remainder — Denki, the bullies, the runaway train, the entrance ceremony — is anime-original: ja-WP says flatly 「イワベエとデンキはアニメオリジナルキャラであるため漫画には登場しない」, and the licensor's synopsis is the Denki story end to end. Cold open = SLIVER (a tease, out of order, the episode never returns to it); ch 1 proper is adapted by eps 53-54, which hold the anchors (ep 53 -> 1 [1] {1}). Remainder decides -> FILLER + graft{1}. EP 24 — the only one AFL gets right, and it is chain material, not Boruto material. Narutopedia maps it to NARUTO ch 700 + 700+5, and TV Tokyo's synopsis gives two of its three sentences to exactly those two chapters' content: the Five Kage gathering in Konoha for a summit and Boruto slipping the tightened security to graffiti the Hokage Rock (ch 700: Gaara arrives for the summit; Udon and Moegi inform the Hokage of his son's prank; Naruto comes to stop him; the Kage begin their meeting) and the Kage secretly weighing Sasuke's intelligence on 大筒木カグヤ (ch 700+5: 'Naruto recalls a Kage meeting where Sasuke revealed a potential new enemy related to Kaguya and the White Zetsu Army'). Both segments significant; the anime-original half (Sarada's Sharingan and shadow-clone training, Chōchō, Konohamaru's tutoring, the Boruto-Sarada spar) is significant too -> MIXED, confirmed as stored. Under I41 that source is a work on the series' READING CHAIN, so it is canon to the series told out of order — `chain_source`{Naruto: ch 700, 700+5} — and POSITION-LESS: a Naruto-space number can never go in the Boruto anchor column (A44, another chapter space). EP 127 — no source content of any size. Narutopedia carries no chapter field on the page (the property is live in this stretch: 148 -> 11, 149 -> 12, 150 -> 13, 151 -> 14/15, 157 -> 11), the licensor's synopsis is the Icha Icha Tactics book hunt end to end, and the two things that could look like source material are not: the Jiraiya photographs and the Sasuke/Naruto backstory are RETOLD Naruto history in dialogue and stills (weightless either way), and the archaeological relic Karasuki that the episode plants is anime-only (Narutopedia `Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 847` = Boruto 127), as is Urashiki in the closing tag (`Appears_in = Anime, Game`). -> FILLER. EP 157 — the Kara Actuation arc's opener, and its whole job is anime-original: Sasuke and Sai in Amegakure with Garashi Tōno, who is anime-only (`Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 877` = Boruto 157); TV Tokyo's synopsis is that investigation and nothing else. The ch-11 tie Narutopedia records is the CODA: Sai's report that Ino's analysis found a third party had been controlling Katasuke and Naruto's decision to reinstate him — ch 11's own B-plot beat ('Ibiki reports to Naruto that Katasuke was being influenced by someone outside the village … Naruto has Ibiki and Sai continue investigating, while Shikamaru deals with Katasuke'), restaged with Ino in Ibiki's place, and skipped by ep 148 when it adapted the rest of ch 11. Weight: SLIVER (a closing status report inside an original plot) -> FILLER + graft{11}. THE SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION was weighed on eps 1 and 157 and refused on both — both halves stated in the rows' own entries. WHO LIED: AFL, three times, by calling a sliver 'Mixed' (1, 127 — where there is no sliver at all — and 157); AFG, once, by bucketing ep 24's real Naruto-manga adaptation as Anime Canon while its own chapter column gives 701-710 to the neighbouring eps 19-23. Narutopedia's chapter field told the truth on all four, INCLUDING the chapter space, which is the field's real value here.

anchor_hostile.why: A1 + A44, and the row is being CORRECTED to filler, so A1 is the primary bar. A44's basis is RE-USE OF PAGES ANOTHER EPISODE OWNS PLUS THE SLIVER CLAUSE, never 'behind an anchor': the only source content is Boruto ch 1's opening flash-forward, played as the pre-OP cold open — Boruto against Kawaki on Naruto's destroyed face in the Hokage Rock, 'the age of shinobi is over', the Jōgan. That is the chapter's first page-set (the chapter's own Narutopedia page opens with exactly those beats), and ch 1's body — Katasuke and the Kote, the exam papers, Himawari's birthday and the dispelled shadow clone, Sasuke at the door — is adapted 52 episodes later by eps 53-54, which hold the anchors (ep 53 -> END 1 START 1 {1}; ep 54 -> 2 [1] {1-2}). An anchor here would put ch 1 on a row whose own plot is the anime's Academy prequel. THE SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION, both halves, because this is the shape it exists for: (a) do the pages appear in no other episode? As far as the sources show, YES — ep 53's synopsis begins ch 1's material at the Urashiki/Toneri addition and the exam papers and never restages the flash-forward, and no later Part-1 episode carries it. (b) Is the beat a major plot point of the source (a death, a reveal, an arc close)? NO — it is the chapter's teaser prologue, a flash-forward to a confrontation the manga does not reach for another sixty-odd chapters; it resolves nothing and progresses nothing here, which is the sliver clause's first named archetype ('a tease'). The exception's purpose is not engaged either: ch 1 is anchored at ep 53, so declining here marks no pages never-adapted. Everything else in the episode is anime-original — ja-WP: 「イワベエとデンキはアニメオリジナルキャラであるため漫画には登場しない」 (Denki and Iwabee are anime-original characters who do not appear in the manga), and TV Tokyo's synopsis is the Denki story end to end (不良たちに絡まれていた少年・雷門デンキを助ける … 忍者学校(アカデミー)入学式へ行く途中).

A44 position-less, NOT A1 — the row is MIXED (stored type confirmed) and its source share is significant, but that share is in ANOTHER CHAPTER SPACE: Naruto ch 700 (the epilogue chapter, vol 72) and ch 700+5 'The Future' (未来は, the Gaiden 'The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring'), which Narutopedia records with an explicit `Manga = Naruto` qualifier while every Boruto-space row in the same map reads `Manga = Boruto`. There is no number in the Boruto 1-80 space that this row could hold, and writing '700' into a Boruto anchor column would be a fabricated position sixty-plus chapters past the manga's end. I41 says the same thing from the other side: material from another work on the series' READING CHAIN is canon told out of order and is POSITION-LESS by construction (A12 / A44), carried by the `chain_source` annotation instead. Nothing is stranded: the Boruto line is intact around this row (eps 19-23 carry the Gaiden's 701-710 in the same Naruto space; the Boruto space's own first anchor is ep 53 -> ch 1), and no Boruto chapter is left unadapted by declining here.

A1: the row is FILLER (corrected from mixed) and there is no source segment of any size to anchor. One segment, the whole episode: Boruto and Sarada hunting down a copy of Jiraiya's 'Icha Icha Tactics' (Shino and Kiba at the flea market, Chōji and Chōchō's stall, the old-book stall, Sasuke's refusal, Hinata's photographs), plus the tag in which Naruto tells Sasuke that Urashiki has been stealing chakra. Evidence: (a) Narutopedia carries no chapter field on the page and the episode is absent from the SMW chapter map, which is live and dense in this exact stretch (148 -> 11, 149 -> 12, 150 -> 13, 151 -> 14/15, 157 -> 11) — a real negative on a maintained field; (b) TV Tokyo's own synopsis is the book hunt end to end (父ナルトのかつての師匠、自来也の話を聞いたボルトは … 早速本を探し始めるボルトたち); (c) the two things that could be mistaken for source material are not source material — the archaeological relic the episode plants (Karasuki, the time-travel tool of the arc that follows) is anime-only on Narutopedia's own record (`Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 847`, the franchise-cumulative number for Boruto 127), and Urashiki in the closing tag is `Appears_in = Anime, Game`; the Jiraiya material is retold Naruto backstory in dialogue and photo stills, which adapts no pages and is weightless in any case. No page tie of any size, so no graft, no loose_parallel, and the sole-adaptation exception is never reached. ja-WP files the row under タイムスリップ編, the arc it describes as Kishimoto's 20th-anniversary IDEA for an anime-original story — note that the stored adoption record on this series covers 128-136 only, and this verdict does not extend it (see flags).

A1 + A44, and the row is being CORRECTED to filler. A44's basis is THE SLIVER CLAUSE ON A FIRST-TIME FRAGMENT INSIDE AN ORIGINAL PLOT (the ranma-130 shape), never 'behind an anchor': the episode's job is the anime-original Kara Actuation opener — Sasuke and Sai's investigation of the abandoned Amegakure waterworks with Garashi Tōno, who is anime-only (Narutopedia `Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 877` = Boruto 157) — and TV Tokyo's synopsis is exactly that and nothing else (サスケとサイが“雨隠れの里”にある謎の組織「殻」のアジトと思われる場所を訪れた … ガラシの案内で、アジトの捜索、調査をすることになる). The ch-11 tie Narutopedia records is the closing coda: Sai asking whether Naruto has seen Ino's report on Katasuke, the finding that a third party had been controlling him, and Naruto's decision to reinstate him — ch 11's own B-plot beat ('Ibiki reports to Naruto that Katasuke was being influenced by someone outside the village, and is in great shock … Naruto has Ibiki and Sai continue investigating, while Shikamaru deals with Katasuke'), restaged with Ino in Ibiki's place. THE SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION, both halves: (a) do the pages appear in no other episode? Probably yes — ep 148 adapted ch 11's A-plot (the bank robbers, Tentō's arrival, the cards) and skipped this beat, and ep 66 carries only ch 11's opening (Momoshiki's warning, Sasuke's advice); so this looks like the anime's only rendering of those panels. (b) Is the beat a major plot point of the source (a death, a reveal, an arc close)? NO — it is a two-panel status report in the chapter's B-plot, the kind of trivial first-time beat T28 names when it says a duplicate graft or a trivial first-time beat stays filler; the source's spine at ch 11 (the Mujina Bandits, Tentō, the new mission) is carried in full by eps 148-151, so nothing is marked never-adapted. Half (b) fails, so the exception does not flip the row; the remainder decides and it is entirely anime-original. Sizing caveat, stated rather than hidden: no source gives a minute count or a page count for the coda — the SHARE is my reading of Narutopedia's ch-11 summary against its ep-157 summary and the licensor's synopsis, all three of which put the episode's weight on the Amegakure investigation.

annotations.note: weight: SLIVER — because it is a tease, played as the pre-OP cold open and never returned to: Boruto ch 1's first page-set (Boruto facing Kawaki on Naruto's destroyed face in the Hokage Rock, Kawaki declaring the age of shinobi over, Boruto's damaged forehead protector and the Jōgan) grafted onto an episode whose own plot — Denki, the bullies, the runaway train, the entrance ceremony — is anime-original prequel material. ja-WP states the relation exactly: 「冒頭場面こそ漫画と同じだが、…漫画の1話目から映像化するのではなく、前日譚となる「忍者学校入学編」から始まる」. IT IS CANON MATERIAL AND IT CARRIES NO WEIGHT: it earns neither the type nor a position, the remainder decides (filler), and CH 1 IS ADAPTED PROPERLY BY EPS 53-54 — ep 53 'Himawari's Birthday' takes the chapter's body (Katasuke and the Kote, the exam papers, Himawari's birthday and the dispelled shadow clone, Sasuke at the door) and holds the anchor END 1 START 1 {1}; ep 54 finishes into ch 2. Read ch 1 there. NEW vs DUPLICATE: the flash-forward pages themselves are NEW here and are not restaged in ep 53 or any later Part-1 episode as far as the sources show — that is why the sole-adaptation exception was weighed (and refused on its second half; see the ep-1 anchor_hostile entry).

THE WORK: the original Naruto manga — ch 700 'Uzumaki Naruto!!' (うずまきナルト!!, vol 72, the epilogue) and ch 700+5 'The Future' (未来は, the ten-chapter Gaiden 'Naruto: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring', serialised as 700+1 … 700+10 and numbered 701-710 by Narutopedia). Boruto is the sequel manga to Naruto by the same hand (I17 already records the sequel relation to naruto-shippuden), so under I41 this is a work on the series' READING CHAIN, not a foreign source: the material is CANON to the series, told out of order, and position-less — see flags, the chain map for this series does not exist yet and must be added or the census will read this record as chain_source_unmapped. SEGMENT WEIGHTS. ch 700 — weight: SIGNIFICANT: it is the episode's frame and its closing beat (the Five Kage converging on Konoha for the summit; Boruto recruiting Shikadai and Inojin for the prank; the successful vandalism of the Hokage Rock; Moegi reporting it to Naruto — the chapter's own beats: 'Gaara arrives in Konohagakure for the next Kage Summit … Udon and Moegi inform the current Hokage of his son's prank on the Hokage Rock. Naruto arrives to stop his son's hijinks from where the Kage Summit takes place'). ch 700+5 — weight: SIGNIFICANT: the Kage's closed-door deliberation over Sasuke's intelligence on 大筒木カグヤ, the White Zetsu and the enemy still to come, which TV Tokyo's synopsis gives its own paragraph (五影たちには、…大筒木カグヤに関して、サスケが手にいれた情報を極秘に検討する必要があり). The anime-original half — Sarada's Sharingan and shadow-clone training, Chōchō, Konohamaru's tutoring, the Boruto-Sarada spar, Iwabee and Metal's Kage argument — is significant in its own right, which is what makes the row MIXED rather than canon. NO ANCHOR by construction: a Naruto-space number cannot enter the Boruto anchor column (A44), and I41 mints no `rearranged` for chain material, which is out of order with the current source by definition.

The adaptation is LOOSE, and the faithfulness clause says that keeps the standing rather than changing it — recorded so the row is not read as a page-faithful pass over ch 700. Narutopedia's own note: 'This episode can be considered an adaptation of the Naruto chapter 700, although most of the events drastically differ from the events in the chapter and only few of them were adapted closely to the manga, including the Five Kage Summit in Konoha, Boruto inviting Shikadai and Inojin to his new prank, Boruto's successful vandalism on the Hokage Rock and Moegi informing Naruto about his son's antics'; and on the second chapter: 'the discussion on the Five Kage Summit about the impending threat is mostly taken from chapter 700+5, although in the chapter, it took place on a different summit earlier and with Sasuke participating' — i.e. the 700+5 material is RELOCATED from a flashback to an earlier meeting into the present Konoha summit, with Sasuke absent. Ch 700's cast-wide epilogue vignettes (Neji's grave, Tenten's shop, the four retired Kage at Ōnoki's, Mirai, Kakashi and Guy) are not in the episode at all.

annotations.chapters: 11 (the Katasuke report — Ino's finding that a third party controlled him, and his reinstatement)
annotations.note: weight: SLIVER — because it is the closing coda of an episode whose plot is elsewhere: a status report grafted onto the anime-original Amegakure investigation (Garashi Tōno, `Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 877`). The source beat is ch 11's B-plot ('Ibiki reports to Naruto that Katasuke was being influenced by someone outside the village … Under that control, Katasuke also leaked information about the Kote. Naruto has Ibiki and Sai continue investigating, while Shikamaru deals with Katasuke'), restaged with Ino's Psycho Mind Transmission in Ibiki's place — Narutopedia's Katasuke page carries the merged version ('After being interrogated by Ibiki Morino following the battle, Ino Yamanaka used her jutsu on him over and over … Shikamaru stated that once Katasuke recovered, he would reinstate his position'). IT IS CANON MATERIAL AND IT CARRIES NO WEIGHT: the remainder decides (filler), and CH 11 IS ADAPTED PROPERLY BY EP 148 ('A New Mission!!', which takes the chapter's A-plot and holds the anchor END 11 START 11 {11}), with ch 11's opening pages (Momoshiki's warning, Sasuke's advice on the Kāma) already animated in ep 66. NEW vs DUPLICATE: this particular beat is NEW — ep 148 skipped it — which is why the sole-adaptation exception was weighed; it was refused on its second half (a two-panel status report is not a major plot point of the source), see the ep-157 anchor_hostile entry. No source states the coda's length; the share is a reading of the three summaries.

type_corrections.note: STORED mixed -> FILLER. Segment accounting, T28. Segment 1, the pre-OP cold open: Boruto ch 1's opening flash-forward (Boruto vs Kawaki, the ruined Konoha, the Jōgan) — weight: SLIVER, because it is a tease of a confrontation the source does not reach for sixty-odd chapters, it is out of order, and the episode never returns to it; it is canon material and carries no weight (annotated graft{1}; ch 1 proper is adapted by eps 53-54, which hold the anchors). Segment 2, everything after the OP — Denki Kaminarimon, the bullies, the runaway train, the entrance ceremony, the damaged Hokage Rock — weight: SIGNIFICANT and entirely anime-original: ja-WP states 「イワベエとデンキはアニメオリジナルキャラであるため漫画には登場しない」 and frames the whole opening arc as a 前日譚 (prequel) the anime invented rather than the manga's ch 1; TV Tokyo's synopsis is that story end to end. The remainder decides: with the sliver weightless, nothing source-derived is left -> filler (T27). AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' is the label that is wrong; AFG's bucket (Anime Canon -> filler for us) is right. The sole-adaptation exception was weighed and refused — see the anchor_hostile entry for both halves.

CONFIRMED AS STORED — mixed, and AFL is the label that is RIGHT here (AFG's 'Anime Canon' bucket is the outlier, and its own chapter column gives 701-710 to the neighbouring eps 19-23 while printing N/A on this one). Segment accounting, T28. Segment 1, Naruto ch 700: the Five Kage converging on Konoha for the summit, Boruto recruiting Shikadai and Inojin, the successful Hokage-Rock vandalism, Moegi reporting it — weight: SIGNIFICANT (it opens and closes the episode). Segment 2, Naruto ch 700+5: the Kage's closed-door deliberation over Sasuke's intelligence on Kaguya, the White Zetsu and the coming enemy — weight: SIGNIFICANT (TV Tokyo's synopsis gives it its own paragraph). THE SOURCE IS CHAIN MATERIAL, NOT THE BORUTO MANGA: Narutopedia's map qualifies these chapters `Manga = Naruto` while every Boruto-space row reads `Manga = Boruto`, and under I41 a work on the series' reading chain is canon to the series told out of order — recorded as chain_source{Naruto: ch 700, 700+5}, position-less. This is the same shape the catalog already accepts as canon on eps 19-23 (the Gaiden, Naruto chs 701-710, stored canon).

There is NO source segment: Narutopedia carries no chapter field on the page and the episode is absent from a chapter map that is dense on both sides of it (148-151, 157), TV Tokyo's synopsis is the book hunt end to end, and the two candidates for a tie are not ties — Karasuki is anime-only (`Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 847` = Boruto 127) as is Urashiki (`Appears_in = Anime, Game`), and the Jiraiya photographs and the Naruto/Sasuke backstory are RETOLD history in dialogue and stills, which adapts no pages and is weightless in the standing either way. structure.notes: PREMISE CORRECTION (the wave's headline on this series, and it is the SECOND time on this page): the task and the context both say animefillerguide 'prints FILLER (red, no chapter)' on eps 1 / 24 / 127 / 157. It does not. On the live page — https://www.animefillerguide.com/anime/boruto/ (the slug /anime/boruto-naruto-next-generations/ is a 404) — all four rows are BLUE with the note '* Anime Canon' and Chapters = 'N/A': '01. | Boruto Uzumaki! * Anime Canon | N/A | blue blue small', '24. | Boruto and Sarada * Anime Canon | N/A', '127. | Make-Out Tactics * Anime Canon | N/A', '157. | Kara’s Footprints * Anime Canon | N/A'. The nearest red row is 156 'I Can’t Stay in My Slim Form * Filler'. The 'AFG filler' in the flag is OUR DERIVATION and it is correct — lib/afg.ts now maps blue + an 'Anime Canon' note to filler (the wave-2 recommendation landed; afg.ts: type = red ? 'filler' : blue ? (afgLabel === 'anime-canon' ? 'filler' : 'mixed') : …). So the flag class on this series is no longer 'AFG claims chapters we call filler'; it is 'AFL's Mixed bucket vs AFG's Anime-Canon bucket', with NO chapter claim on either side. Worth saying in the flag text so the next wave does not go looking for a red row. ROW IDENTITY (R20 — joined on title AND air date, never index): our four rows, AFL's four rows, AFG's four rows, Narutopedia's four episode pages and ja-WP's four table rows agree on both title and date — 1 'Boruto Uzumaki!' / うずまきボルト!! 2017-04-05; 24 'Boruto and Sarada' / ボルトとサラダ 2017-09-13; 127 'Make-Out Tactics' / イチャイチャタクティクス 2019-10-06; 157 "Kara's Footprints" / 「殻」の足跡 2020-07-19. All four lists carry 293 rows for Part 1. TWO CHAPTER SPACES ON ONE PAGE — the finding that decides ep 24. Narutopedia's per-episode chapter field is exposed as Semantic MediaWiki and carries a `Manga` qualifier: action=askargs&conditions=Anime::Boruto|Manga Chapter::+&printouts=Episode number|Manga Chapter|Manga returns 71 rows, of which SIX are `Manga = Naruto` (19 -> 701,702; 20 -> 702,703,704; 21 -> 705,706; 22 -> 707,708; 23 -> 709,710; 24 -> 700,705) plus ep 106 -> 700, and all the rest are `Manga = Boruto` (1 -> 1; 39 -> 0; 53-66 -> 1-11; 148-151 -> 11-15; 157 -> 11; 181-220 -> 16-58; 287-293 -> 55-70). The SMW property and the infobox `chapters=` / `boruto=` fields are ONE lineage (the template writes the property), so they are one source, not two — the independent legs used here are ja-Wikipedia and TV Tokyo. THE CATALOG ALREADY TREATS NARUTO-SPACE ROWS AS CANON, unannotated: eps 19-23 (the Gaiden, chs 701-710) are stored canon with no chain_source / side_source record, and ep 39 'The Path Lit by the Full Moon' is stored canon for the second Gaiden one-shot (満ちた月が照らす道, printed at the back of Boruto vol 1 and numbered 'ch 0' by Narutopedia; AFG prints its TITLE in the chapters column instead of a number). That is the same I41 shape as ep 24 and it is out of this ask — flagged rather than touched. THE TWO ROWS WHERE THE SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION WAS WEIGHED AND REFUSED, so you can overturn either without re-researching. Ep 1: the cold open is Boruto ch 1's opening flash-forward and, as far as the sources show, no other Part-1 episode restages it (half (a) MET) — I refused on half (b), because a flash-forward prologue teasing a confrontation sixty-odd chapters away is a tease, not a death / reveal / arc close, and ch 1 is anchored at ep 53 so no pages are marked never-adapted. It is the most defensible place in this bundle for a different ruling: if you read the manga's opening hook as a major plot point, ep 1 becomes mixed and could carry an anchor at ch 1 [1] (which would then sit ahead of, not behind, ep 53's). Ep 157: the ch-11 Katasuke beat is likewise first-time (ep 148 skipped it) but is a two-panel status report — refused as a trivial first-time beat. Both are recorded as graft annotations either way, so nothing is lost if you leave them filler.
